title: Luana Silva
bio: I believe in design that feels, not just functions. Built on curiosity, dialogue, and craft, my work explores how form and message shape experience. Every project is a collaboration, grounded in clarity and made to last.
aboutLongBio: My work explores the quiet rhythm between light, texture, and human presence. I move between painting, printmaking, and mixed media — always drawn to subtle tension and stillness. Each piece begins with observation and becomes a search for balance between control and chance.

elements.content: A study of human gatherings, movement, and shared space. Each painting captures fleeting interactions and collective rhythm through softened edges and muted tones. The figures blur into one another, suggesting presence without individuality, echoing the quiet poetry of urban anonymity.

A series of digital portraits exploring contrast, form, and emotion through minimal color and bold composition. Using blue and orange tones, each figure reveals character through clean lines and precise shading. The series focuses on graphic simplicity and expressive geometry.

Infos:
Technique: Digital painting
Year: 2025
Project: Commissioned by Vogue Italia

A quiet narrative series depicting solitary figures in winter settings. The collection combines surreal storytelling with emotional stillness, utilising muted tones, red accents, and textured brushwork to evoke warmth amidst cold landscapes. Each piece invites reflection on solitude, resilience, and imagination.

A series of floral portraits celebrating form, color, and stillness. Each piece captures the rhythm of natural growth through clean composition and controlled tone. The works reinterpret botanical subjects with a graphic, modern sensibility, transforming organic details into quiet design.

A darkly elegant portrait series inspired by Gothic art and celestial iconography. Each piece explores light and shadow through intricate textures, evoking a sense of mystery, divinity, and human fragility. The series blends fantasy and historical influence, reimagined through a digital chiaroscuro style.

A collection of hand-printed works exploring line, contrast, and repetition through the simplicity of a single colour. Each print captures everyday forms—portraits, animals, and architecture—transformed by the tactile quality of ink and texture. The series reflects the rhythm and imperfection of manual printmaking.

A playful series of stylized character studies exploring the geometry of the human body through bold color blocks and flattened perspective. Each figure, caught mid-motion or at rest, reveals rhythm and attitude through shape rather than expression. The contrast between green and orange surfaces enhances the sense of balance and design.

A series of surreal portraits blending animal and human traits. These works explore the line between whimsy and strangeness, where familiar forms take on new personalities. Soft colors, smooth textures, and precise detail create a world that feels still yet alive.
I’m always happy to connect. Reach out with questions, ideas, or project inquiries, and I’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

A floral illustration series exploring texture, balance, and organic form through paper-inspired digital layering. Each piece combines sculptural depth with soft palettes to evoke the calm rhythm of nature. Created as part of a personal portfolio focusing on tactile visual storytelling.
